name: Open a document
description: An illustrative Loom scenario, not live traffic.

steps.name: Open document
steps.description: You choose a document in the application shell.

steps.name: Route the request
steps.description: The gateway asks the Document service to load the document.

steps.name: Find saved content
steps.description: The Document service reads the saved document model.

steps.name: Read document
steps.description: Documents returns the saved model to the service.

steps.name: Load into editor
steps.description: The service response loads the editor document state.

steps.name: Show document
steps.description: The editor sends the loaded state to Rendering.
